alt: A short film with no voice. A night patio under a blue sky with stars and a huge moon almost entirely lit, labeled 98%. A light blue block figure with white eyes stands on the left beside a small clock that reads 7:58 and looks up, then at the clock, with narrowed eyes. An amber figure runs in late from the right, stops with a thump, and gets a narrowed look. Then both look up at the moon, and the amber one smiles. The text stays: if this found you: the moon is full tomorrow. It has never once been late. You have.
